agritech.marketplace.newListing.title: New listing
agritech.marketplace.newListing.descript: Fill in everything the catalog and its filters read, then send the listing for moderation.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.kindFixe: Your verified role decides what you list, so there is nothing to choose here. A seller lists seeds, inputs and machinery; a farmer lists a harvest.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.hint.tit: All four names are published: a shopper reading in Russian or Uzbek sees the name for that language, never an English fallback.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.hint.pro: The crop is the published title of a harvest listing. Produce carries no separate name per language.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.hint.reg: Choose a region already in the catalog so the listing joins an existing filter.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.hint.ava: A harvest reaches the catalog only while its window is open: a listing that starts in the future stays invisible until that date, and disappears after the closing date.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.photos.d: A photograph from your device cannot be stored: this deployment has no file storage for listing images.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.photos.h: Choose up to {{limit}} photographs from the marketplace library. They are published with the listing.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.photos.p: A harvest listing carries no photographs at all: produce has no image field, so the catalog draws its crop illustration.
The listing is created and submitted at once. It stays invisible to shoppers until a moderator approves it.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.submitBu: Creating the listing and submitting it for moderation…
agritech.marketplace.newListing.errors.s: Some fields still need attention. Each one is named below.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.error.wh: {{field}}: enter a whole number of at least {{minimum}}.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.error.ph: {{field}}: one chosen photograph is not in the marketplace library.

Verification decides what you can list

A buying account posts purchase requests instead of listings. Farmers list a harvest and sellers list seeds, inputs and machinery; creating a listing is outside a buyer role rather than a step still to complete.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.success: The listing was created and submitted for moderation. It appears in the catalog once a moderator approves it.
agritech.marketplace.newListing.successU: The listing was created but not submitted for moderation: {{reason}} Submit it from the publication queue.
